description: Source code for agent lifecycle management HTTP handlers in a web service, including starting, stopping, status retrieval, listing, and reconciliation of agents.

classes.name: LifecycleHandler
classes.description: HTTP handler struct for managing agent lifecycle operations.

methods.name: NewLifecycleHandler
methods.description: Constructor for LifecycleHandler, initializes with storage and agent service dependencies.

methods.name: getAgentBaseURL
methods.description: Retrieves the base URL for an agent, falling back to localhost if not registered.

methods.name: buildEndpoints
methods.description: Constructs endpoint URLs for agent health, reasoners, and skills based on base URL.

methods.name: StartAgentHandler
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to start an agent with optional configuration.

methods.name: StopAgentHandler
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to stop a running agent.

methods.name: GetAgentStatusHandler
methods.description: Retrieves current status and metadata of an agent.

methods.name: ListRunningAgentsHandler
methods.description: Lists all currently running agents with metadata.

methods.name: ReconcileAgentHandler
methods.description: Reconciles agent state with actual process state.
